note: Aggregate metrics only. Computed on the PhysioNet Zigong HF dataset (restricted access). No patient-level data is included here or anywhere in this repository, per the data-use agreement. Regenerate with src/validation/zigong_cohort.py + run_validation.py; see VALIDATION.md.
dataset: Zigong Fourth People's Hospital HF cohort (PhysioNet, heart-failure-zigong v1.3)
features: 27 curated admission-day clinical predictors + medication (GDMT-class) features, one-hot expanded to ~52 columns; leakage-guarded (outcome/discharge/emergency columns excluded)

published_benchmark_same_cohort.source: Predicting Six-Month Re-Admission Risk in Heart Failure Patients Using Multiple Machine Learning Methods, J. Clin. Med. 2023;12(3):870 (same Zigong cohort, same outcome, same 70:30 held-out design)
published_benchmark_same_cohort.comparison: this project's 0.649 is on par (overlapping CIs); ~0.63-0.65 is the achievable ceiling on this cohort regardless of method

secondary_outcome.note: Underpowered (~21 test events); GBT does not clearly beat the baseline.

medication_data_caveat.note: The medication table has only 25 unique drug names total and is a limited/curated list of unknown completeness (metoprolol is the only beta-blocker recorded; benazepril and valsartan the only RAASi; no SGLT2i/ARNI; no doses). These recorded-presence rates therefore cannot be read as GDMT prescribing rates or titration adequacy, and no guideline-adherence conclusion is drawn from them; used only as model inputs, which did not improve discrimination.
